verdicts.rationale: Jackendoff, Consciousness and the Computational Mind. Identical title and ISBN (9780262100373) across all three; year differs only 1987 vs 1990 (printings). Same work.
William James, 'The will to believe' (1897), same title/author/year/publisher/ISBN. Same work; second member simply omits booktitle/pages.
Johnston & Slobin, locative expressions, JCL 6(3):529-545. All three share the DOI and identical fields. Same work.
Kaiser & Grosz, 'Anaphoricity in emoji', PLSA 6(1):1009. Shared DOI, identical fields; only entry type differs (article vs misc). Same work.
Katz & Fodor, 'The Structure of a Semantic Theory', Language 39(2):170-210. Shared DOI, identical fields. Same work.
Kennedy, A Psychology of Picture Perception (1974, Jossey-Bass). Identical title/author/year/publisher. Same work.
Kiparsky & Kiparsky, 'Fact' (1971). Same authors/title/year; the two members give different anthology reprints (Progress in Linguistics vs Semantics reader) of the same essay. Same underlying work.

Lettvin, Maturana, McCulloch & Pitts, 'What the Frog's Eye Tells the Frog's Brain'. Three share the DOI (1959 Proc IRE); the fourth (1968 incollection in 'The Mind') is the standard reprint of the same paper. Same work.

Lévi-Strauss, The Elementary Structures of Kinship. Same title/author; 1949 (Eyre & Spottiswoode) vs 1969 (Beacon Press) are the original and the English translation of the same work. Same underlying work.

FALSE MERGE. The DOI/title fields all point to Peter Lewis, 'Antiaesthetics: An Appreciation of the Cow with the Subtile Nose' (Philosophical Books 27, 1986) — but the four citekeys (lewis1986causation, lewis1986counterfactual, lewis1986postscript, lewis1986subjectivists) denote four DISTINCT David Lewis papers (from Philosophical Papers Vol. II). All four were mis-authenticated to the same wrong Crossref record. Survivor lewis1986causation is kept; the other three are genuinely distinct works and must not be archived.
Linsker, 'From basic network principles to neural architecture', PNAS 83(21):8390-8394. Shared DOI, identical fields. Same work.
Lopes, Sight and Sensibility (OUP). Identical title/author/publisher/ISBN; year differs only 2005 vs 2006. Same work.
Zacks et al., 'Event perception: A mind-brain perspective', Psych Bulletin 133(2):273-293. Shared DOI, identical fields; only note differs. Same work.
Maloney, 'Surface Colour Perception and Environmental Constraints', in Colour Perception (2003). Shared DOI, identical fields. Same work.
Marr, 'Visual information processing...', Phil Trans R Soc B 290(1038):199-218. Shared DOI, identical fields. Same work.
Mazer et al., 'Spatial frequency and orientation tuning dynamics in area V1', PNAS 99(3):1645-1650. Shared DOI, identical fields. Same work.

Parsons, Nonexistent Objects (1980, Yale). Identical title/author/year/publisher/ISBN. Same work.
